finding_key: packages/docs/src/export/pdf-image-painter.ts::new image-fetch guard aborts the whole docs pdf/docx export when one image is refused — the exporters have no per-image catch
evidence: The mechanics are correctly read (pdf-image-painter.ts:60 and docx-exporter.ts collectImages have no per-image catch, and the new guard throws), but the claimed regression is not: the pre-change fetcher already threw on any non-OK response, so docs export was always all-or-nothing on image failures — there was no "PDF with a missing image" behavior to lose. The only new abort condition (internal-host images refused by default) is the PR's deliberate, documented fail-closed policy with an operator escape hatch (WAFFLEBASE_IMAGE_HOSTS, named in the refusal message and README), and skipping images silently is explicitly rejected by the codebase's own comments (pdf-image-painter.ts:19-21). The slides-path inconsistency (packages/slides/src/export/pdf.ts:282) could not be verified — that file is not available in this run.
